P0004.alt: A white sign on a blue stucco wall above a weathered wooden bench beside a potted olive tree.
P0004.ttag: Kwontified partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor to attend NRF 2018: Retail’s Big Show
P0004.desc: Partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend NRF 2018: Retail’s Big Show, the National Retail Federation’s annual conference, from January 14 to 16…
P0004.body:
SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — January 5, 2018 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend NRF 2018: Retail’s Big Show, the National Retail Federation’s annual conference, from January 14 to 16 at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York.

Brands that want to meet the team in New York, or arrange a call during or after the show, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • How Walmart plans to compete online, as Walmart president and chief executive Doug McMillon speaks with NRF chief executive Matthew Shay on the show’s first day, January 14.
  • What Facebook and Instagram plan for shopping, with executives from both companies on the speaker list.
  • How stores respond to a holiday season in which online sales grew 18.1% while total retail sales grew 4.9%, according to Mastercard SpendingPulse.

“Shoppers now start most product searches on a marketplace, and the retailers on stage at NRF know it,” said Elaine Kwon, partner at Kwontified. “We are going to New York to hear how the largest retailers plan to answer, because their choices this year will decide where brands need to show up, and what it will cost them to be found.”

Kwontified will publish a summary of what the show signals for brands after the event.

About Kwontified

Kwontified is an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm that helps brands plan, run and measure their business on Amazon, Walmart and other marketplaces. Learn more at kwontified.com.

A0447.body:
Kwontified managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor to attend Amazon Accelerate 2023 in Seattle

SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — September 5, 2023 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend Amazon Accelerate 2023, Amazon’s annual conference for selling partners, on September 13 and 14 at the Seattle Convention Center. Pre-conference activities for in-person attendees begin at noon on September 12.

Brands and sellers who want to meet the team in Seattle, or arrange a video meeting during or after the event, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • Seller verification and brand protection, after the INFORM Consumers Act took effect in June and changed what marketplaces must know about high-volume sellers.
  • Generative AI tools for sellers, and whether they help brands produce better product listings and answer customers faster without losing accuracy.
  • Planning for the rest of the year, including Amazon’s fall event and how fees, fulfillment and advertising costs shape holiday budgets.

“The brands we work with are being asked to do more with every dollar, on more marketplaces, with tools that are changing quickly,” said Elaine Kwon, managing partner at Kwontified. “Accelerate is where Amazon tells sellers what it is building next. We will be in Seattle listening for the changes that matter most to brands, and we will share what we learn with the brands we work with.”

Kwontified will publish a summary of the announcements that matter for brands after the event.

Kwontified managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor to attend Amazon Ads unBoxed 2023 in New York

SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — October 16, 2023 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend Amazon Ads unBoxed 2023, Amazon’s annual advertising conference, from October 24 to 26 at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York.

Brands and advertisers who want to meet the team in New York, or arrange a video meeting during or after the event, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • Advertising on Prime Video, which Amazon has said will carry limited ads starting in early 2024, and how brands can plan and measure streaming video alongside their search advertising.
  • Measurement tools that connect advertising to sales, including how brands can test which ads add sales they would not otherwise have made.
  • Planning for the holiday season and 2024, including how advertising budgets should be set across search, display and streaming as competition for shoppers’ attention grows.

“Amazon’s advertising options are growing faster than most brands can test them,” said Jordan Taylor, managing partner at Kwontified. “unBoxed is where Amazon explains what it is building for advertisers. We will be in New York looking for the changes that will help brands spend more wisely, and we will share what we learn with the brands we work with.”

Kwontified will publish a summary of the announcements that matter for brands after the event.

SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — September 9, 2024 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend Amazon Accelerate 2024, Amazon’s annual conference for selling partners, from September 17 to 19 at the Seattle Convention Center Summit Building.

Brands and sellers who want to meet the team in Seattle, where Kwontified has an office, or arrange a video meeting during or after the conference, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • New tools for sellers, including how Amazon is using generative AI to create and improve product listings, and how brands can use those tools without losing accuracy.
  • Fulfillment and inventory planning ahead of the holiday season, including the deadlines and costs that shape how much stock brands should send to Amazon before the busiest weeks of the year.
  • The connection between selling and advertising, including how sellers can measure which promotions and ads add sales rather than simply moving them from one week to another.

“Accelerate is where Amazon explains what it is building for the businesses that sell in its store,” said Elaine Kwon, managing partner at Kwontified. “We will be in Seattle listening for the changes that affect how brands plan their inventory, content and advertising for the holidays and for 2025, and we will share what we learn with the brands we work with.”

A0638.body:
SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — October 4, 2024 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend Amazon Ads unBoxed 2024, Amazon’s annual advertising conference, from October 14 to 16 in Austin, Texas.

Brands and advertisers who want to meet the team in Austin, or arrange a video meeting during or after the conference, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • Streaming and video advertising, including how brands can use Prime Video ads, which Amazon introduced in January, alongside sponsored ads to reach shoppers before they search.
  • Measurement, including how advertisers can show which campaigns add sales rather than simply claiming sales that would have happened anyway, a question that matters more as budgets grow.
  • AI tools for creative and campaign management, following the video and listing tools Amazon introduced for sellers in September, and how brands can use them without losing control of quality.

“Amazon’s advertising business keeps growing faster than its retail business, and brands are spending more of their budgets there every year,” said Jordan Taylor, managing partner at Kwontified. “We will be in Austin to understand what is changing in Amazon’s ad products and measurement before the holiday season, so the brands we work with can plan their spending with evidence rather than habit.”

Kwontified will publish a summary of the announcements that matter for brands after the conference, including what they mean for holiday advertising plans.

Kwontified managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor to attend Amazon Accelerate 2025 in Seattle

SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — September 8, 2025 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend Amazon Accelerate 2025, Amazon’s annual selling partner conference, from September 16 to 18 in Seattle.

Brands and sellers who want to meet the team in Seattle, or arrange a video meeting during or after the conference, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • Fees and promotions, following Amazon’s June change to deal and coupon fees, which now charge a share of promotion sales, and what further changes sellers should plan for.
  • Holiday readiness, as sellers finalize deals, stock and budgets for Amazon’s October event and Black Friday, with Prime Big Deal Days deal submissions closing on September 12.
  • AI tools for sellers, including how Amazon’s assistants and listing tools change the way products are found and how brands keep control of quality.

“The fall calendar now asks sellers to commit deals, stock and budgets weeks before the events they are planning for,” said Elaine Kwon, managing partner at Kwontified. “We will be in Seattle to understand what Amazon is changing for sellers before the holiday season, so the brands we work with can make those decisions with the full picture.”

Kwontified will publish a summary of the announcements that matter for brands after the conference, including what they mean for holiday plans.

A0822.body:
Kwontified managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor to attend Amazon Ads unBoxed 2025 in Nashville

SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — November 3, 2025 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced that managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor will attend unBoxed 2025, Amazon Ads’ annual advertising conference, from November 10 to 12 in Nashville.

Brands and advertisers who want to meet the team in Nashville, or arrange a video meeting during or after the conference, can write to sales@kwontified.com.

The team will be watching three areas closely:

  • Upper-funnel advertising, after advertisers shifted spending toward Amazon DSP during October’s Prime Big Deal Days, where DSP clicks rose 26% year over year among advertisers tracked by Skai.
  • AI tools for advertisers, following Amazon’s September launch of AI tools for building ads in Creative Studio, and how much control brands keep as these tools take on more work.
  • Cyber Week readiness, as deals submitted by the October 28 deadline go live and brands set final budgets and bids for the busiest weeks of the year.

“Advertisers came out of October with steady click costs but smaller baskets, and they are moving money up the funnel,” said Jordan Taylor, managing partner at Kwontified. “We will be in Nashville to see which new tools help brands grow profitably, and which simply add complexity, so the brands we work with can plan their holiday and 2026 budgets with confidence.”

Kwontified will publish a summary of the announcements that matter for brands after the conference.

A0996.title: Kwontified launches Perspectives and the Kwontified Briefing newsletter
A0996.alt: A white sign on a blue stucco wall above a weathered wooden bench beside a potted olive tree.
A0996.ttag: Kwontified launches Perspectives and the Kwontified Briefing newsletter
A0996.desc: Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced the launch of Perspectives, its articles on…
A0996.body:
SANDY SPRINGS, Ga. — November 3, 2026 — Kwontified, an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm, today announced the launch of Perspectives, its articles on kwontified.com, and the Kwontified Briefing, a newsletter for brands that sell on Amazon, Walmart, Target and other marketplaces.

Perspectives publishes analysis by managing partners Elaine Kwon and Jordan Taylor on retail media, marketplace operations and the shift to AI shopping assistants. At launch, 913 articles are available at kwontified.com/perspectives.

The Kwontified Briefing arrives by email once a month. Each issue leads with one finding brands can act on, followed by short briefs on the news that matters and links to new Kwontified articles. Readers can subscribe at kwontified.com/subscribe.

Both are written for the people who run brands on marketplaces:

  • Retail media and advertising, including how Amazon, Walmart and Target are rebuilding ad buying around AI agents.
  • Retail events, with forecasts before major sales and an honest grade of those forecasts afterward.
  • Marketplace operations, from inventory and fees to unauthorized resellers and new marketplaces.

“Brands are making more decisions, faster, with less clear information from the platforms they sell on,” said Jordan Taylor, managing partner at Kwontified. “Perspectives and the Briefing share what we see across the accounts we manage, in plain terms, so brand leaders can act on it.”

About Kwontified

Kwontified is an e-commerce channel management, marketing and technology services firm that helps brands plan, run and measure their business on Amazon, Walmart, Target and other marketplaces. Learn more at kwontified.com.
